title: CRAFT: CULTURAL RUSSIAN-ORIENTED DATASET ADAPTATION FOR FOCUSED TEXT-TO-IMAGE GENERATION
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of Russian cultural concepts, including religious elements like Orthodox holidays, measured by human evaluation of text-to-image generation quality (text alignment and visual appeal).
findings: The paper's main finding is that fine-tuning a text-to-image model on a culturally specific dataset (which includes a 'Religion' category focusing on Russian Orthodox concepts) significantly improves its ability to generate culturally relevant images. The paper does not provide specific metrics or findings for the religion category alone, but the overall improvement of the Kandinsky 3.1 model suggests enhanced performance in this domain as well.
references: James Betker, Gabriel Goh, Li Jing, Tim Brooks, Jianfeng Wang, Linjie Li, Long Ouyang, Juntang Zhuang, Joyce Lee, Yufei Guo, Wesam Manassra, Prafulla Dhariwa, Casey Chu, Yunxin Jiao, and Aditya Ramesh. Improving image generation with better captions, 2023.
